glosses: definition (a statement of the meaning of a word)
definition (a clear instance conforming to the dictionary or textbook definition)
definition (clarity of visual presentation, distinctness of outline or detail)

examples.text: Estoy totalmente de acuerdo con su definición de la amistad.
examples.en: I totally agree with his definition of friendship.
There are different definitions of democracy.

examples.text: Por sobre todo, la lógica requiere definiciones precisas.
examples.en: Above all, logic requires precise definitions.
